brief: 6 internal tools every AI startup ships in week 1 — concrete examples.

slots.title: 1. Slack, the alert hub
slots.body: Pipe model failures and deployment notices into a single channel so the team reacts in seconds, not hours.

slots.title: 2. Notion, the prompt vault
slots.body: Centralize every system prompt, few-shot example, and output template so context stays consistent across experiments.

slots.title: 3. GitHub, the code gate
slots.body: Enforce pre-commit hooks, type checks, and LLM-generated test coverage before any branch reaches main.

slots.title: 4. Linear, the task router
slots.body: Tag bugs by model version and customer segment so engineers know exactly what to fix first.

slots.title: 5. Supabase, the data layer
slots.body: Store user sessions, embeddings, and metadata in one Postgres instance with Row Level Security enabled.

slots.title: 6. Loom, the stand-in
slots.body: Record two-minute demos of model behavior to replace daily standups and keep remote teams aligned.
